CHALLENGER.MISSING_CHALLENGER: You're not currently participating in an A to Z Challenge. Click the button below to start a new challenge!
CHALLENGER.MISSING_ACCOUNT: To participate in the A to Z Challenge, you must first link a Riot account.

MODAL_LINK_ACCOUNT.TITLE: Verify Riot ID
MODAL_LINK_ACCOUNT.DESCRIPTION: Before participating in a challenge, we need to find your official Riot Games profile and verify that you own the account.
MODAL_LINK_ACCOUNT.VERIFY_DESCRIPTION: To confirm that this Riot account belongs to you, temporarily change your summoner icon to the icon below. After changing it in the League of Legends client, click "Verify Account".
MODAL_LINK_ACCOUNT.RIOT_ID_INVALID_FORMAT: Riot ID must include the hashtag (example: AURA Galactus#BR1)
MODAL_LINK_ACCOUNT.PLAYER_NOT_FOUND: Player not found on Riot servers. Check if the Riot ID and tag were entered correctly.
MODAL_LINK_ACCOUNT.SERVER_CONNECTION_ERROR: Internal server error while connecting to Riot services.
MODAL_LINK_ACCOUNT.VERIFICATION_EXPIRED: The verification has expired. Click reset and try again.
MODAL_LINK_ACCOUNT.ICON_CHECK_ERROR: Unable to verify the current profile icon.
MODAL_LINK_ACCOUNT.ICON_MISMATCH: The current icon does not match the verification icon. If you already changed it, wait a few seconds and try again. Riot servers may take some time to return the updated information.
